thesis: Facts, causes and values must remain separate when expertise informs decisions.
role: Explain the authority, access and responsibility attached to laws.

ideas.statement: Reproducibility can counter arbitrary authority, but access, prestige and publication incentives shape correction and recognition.
Predictive decisions can change the mechanism predicted; observed differences and causes do not establish what treatment or policy is deserved.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Rejecting every regularity also harms people relying on verifiable standards; trust should be accountable rather than blind or absent.
